_comment: Compilation units for the Go archetype samples. See harness.py for the rules.
files: every archetype with ```go blocks -> the heading above each block, in order. A mismatch in
count or heading fails the run, so a new or moved block can't be compiled as the wrong code.
skip: blocks not compiled, each with a reason; a 'comment-only' reason is verified.
units[].files[].blocks: 'file.md#N' or 'file.md#N-M'. A file whose first block has a package clause
is used verbatim; a fragment gets 'package' here and its imports from goimports (candidates: 'imports').
units[].stubs: harness-only files for types the archetypes leave to the project (testdata/stubs).
